remarks: Beautifully Maintained & Move-In Ready 1-Bedroom Apartment in Prime Location.  Spacious and freshly updated 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit located in a quiet, sought-after community in the heart of town. This well-kept apartment features a generously sized bedroom, multiple closets, and brand-new flooring throughout. The kitchen has been refreshed with newly painted cabinets and countertops, and the bathroom has also been improved. The entire unit has been freshly painted, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry with a brand-new washer and dryer, central air conditioning, ceiling fans, and a private balcony-perfect for relaxing mornings or watching evening sunsets. Includes an assigned parking space. Prime location with easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and the South Norwalk train station. Close to shopping, dining, and entertainment. All the windows in the unit are going to be replaced in about 3 weeks.
